name: codingagent
description: An OpenCode-style coding agent: Node.js + TypeScript engine, Vue 3 UI, Tauri 2 desktop & mobile shells

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,web "npm run dev -w @codingagent/server" "npm run dev -w @codingagent/web"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @codingagent/server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @codingagent/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @codingagent/server && npm run build -w @codingagent/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @codingagent/server && npm run typecheck -w @codingagent/web
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run db:migrate -w @codingagent/server
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:shared && npm run desktop:dev -w @codingagent/desktop
